scope: Production DoublyLinkedList<int> linked into .NET harness; not Unity runtime, Card lifecycle, AI or gameplay latency
method: Seven trials after lookup warmup. Median includes loop/modulo/hash costs; append timing excludes donor construction but includes receiver index allocation and node ownership transfer. Wall-clock noise, GC and JIT affect timings. No latency threshold or asymptotic claim inferred from timings alone.
